title: South Lebanon: Locals remain as war rages on
summary: 🇱🇧 "Nowhere is safe." Mere kilometres from the #Israel-#Lebanon border, FRANCE 24 accompanied a humanitarian aid convoy headed to the town of #Marjayoun. For the thousands that still remain in the region, convoys like this are their last resort for essential necessities. Our reporters Melina Huet and Achraf Abid bring you this story.
